Professional validation dependencies (product license is not selected here)

DirectXTex 2.1.1 / may2026: MIT, static linkage. See DirectXTex-LICENSE.txt.
Alembic 1.8.12: BSD-3-Clause, static linkage, Ogawa only. See Alembic-LICENSE.txt.
OpenEXR 3.5.2 and Imath 3.2.3: BSD-3-Clause, shared linkage.
libdeflate 1.26: MIT; OpenJPH 0.32.0: BSD-2-Clause; zstd 1.5.7:
BSD-3-Clause or GPL-2.0. Their unmodified notices are included alongside this file.
Binary redistribution must carry the applicable upstream copyright notices.
Exact validation DLL and archive hashes are in cmake/dependencies.lock.json.

Qt 6.12.0 Quick and Gui are dynamically linked. Upstream offers commercial
and LGPL/GPL licensing alternatives; no commercial entitlement is assumed.
The selected rendering target uses QQuickRhiItem and Qt GuiPrivate, not Quick3D.
Qt Quick3D is a separately tested external candidate (commercial or GPLv3)
and is not linked into these targets. Qt ShaderTools qsb is a build tool;
the application does not link the shader compiler runtime or ship qsb.
Distributing Qt requires the applicable Qt license texts, third-party notices,
corresponding source/relinking provisions, and permitting library replacement
under the chosen applicable terms. A portable distribution is not supplied here.
Module-specific attributions must accompany any future Qt binary package.

Upstream references:
